notes: GIF assets are converted to temporary MP4 with ffmpeg before upload.
This media judge is evidence-quality QA; it does not replace backend/browser production gates.

asset.title: Video
asset.purpose: Live Playwright browser proof clip. Judge only visible product evidence: multi-client sync, advisory presence, no-clobber behavior, proposals, job/privacy/wall surfaces, and production honesty.

judge.summary: The video demonstrates a complete end-to-end workflow of NodeAgent, from room creation and spreadsheet data upload to invoking an AI agent for financial analysis and viewing the generated PDF report.

featureClarity.evidence: Clearly shows the collaborative workspace, spreadsheet viewer, and AI agent interaction panel.

workflowCompleteness.evidence: Captures the entire sequence: landing page, file upload, agent execution with real-time logs, and final PDF deliverable.

visualDesign.evidence: High-density dark UI with a clean layout, though some log panels are text-heavy.

consistency.evidence: Perfectly aligns with the product concept of collaborative rooms, spreadsheets, and agent traces.

evidenceQuality.evidence: Authentic screen recording of a live browser session showing actual execution steps.

legibility.evidence: Most UI text and spreadsheet cells are readable, though log text is small.

professionalRelevance.evidence: Highly relevant to financial analysts, demonstrating automated valuation and report generation.

productionHonesty.evidence: Shows real-time agent execution, including transient tool failures and retries.

observedEvidence: Agent task brief execution with live trace logs
Generation and rendering of PDF export deliverable
judge.suggestedReadmeCaption: Watch NodeAgent process financial spreadsheets, execute a valuation task, and compile a final PDF report in real-time.
